mechanism_narrative: A downward trend in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 months, or rank correlation between FEDFUNDS trend and SPX returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals a labor market becoming less tight, reducing wage-driven inflation risk and enabling accommodative Fed policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE > 5.5%, or rank correlation between UNRATE>5.5% and SPX returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals broad demand contraction, triggering flight to quality and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as central bank intervention is anticipated.
failure_condition: The condition (HOUST<1000 and INDPRO<100) occurs, but SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or rank correlation between condition and SPX returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY), market pricing of tightening leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the Fed pauses or reverses.
failure_condition: The condition (FEDFUNDS>2.5% and CPIAUCSL>2.5% YoY) occurs, but SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or rank correlation between condition and SPX returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals manufacturing contraction, triggering flight to safety and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as central bank support is anticipated.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 occurs, but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or rank correlation between INDPRO<100 and SPX returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months indicates strengthening real economy, supporting corporate earnings growth and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST trend (upward) occurs, but SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or rank correlation between HOUST trend and SPX returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals deteriorating labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as Fed rate cuts are anticipated.
failure_condition: The condition (PAYEMS growth<0% and UNRATE increase>0.3% mo/mo) occurs, but SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or rank correlation between condition and SPX returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle supply contraction (INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 growth < 2% annualized), the S&P 500 experiences temporary dip followed by rebound as Fed intervenes, leading to positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The condition (INDPRO<100 and GDPC1 growth<2% annualized) occurs, but SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or rank correlation between condition and SPX returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
